string.name: gboard_patches_error_header_summary
string.translation: This settings page failed to load and was safely disabled.

string.name: gboard_patches_error_row_summary
string.translation: The host app stayed alive. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_fatal_fallback_summary
string.translation: This screen hit an internal error and was safely disabled. Gboard stays alive. Reopen settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_restart_failed
string.translation: Gboard could not be restarted. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_group_ai_voice_summary
string.translation: AI writing tools, advanced voice typing, and Bluetooth microphone.

string.name: gboard_patches_group_keyboard_empty_summary
string.translation: This build does not include any keyboard settings features.

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_package_warning_message
string.translation: The current Gboard package is %1$s. PixelBoard Patches supports only the official package com.google.android.inputmethod.latin and com.akshaykadam.pixelboard. Mixing Gboard builds from multiple sources may cause instability.

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_launch_failed
string.translation: Unable to open Developer options for %1$s.

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_summary
string.translation: Controls Gboard AI Writing Tools availability, keyboard support, and backend routing.

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_error_summary
string.translation: The AI Writing Tools settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_enabled_summary
string.translation: Show AI writing tools in the suggestion strip for instant proofreading, text rewriting, and smart suggestions. Restart Gboard to apply changes.

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_all_keyboards_summary
string.translation: Enable AI Writing Tools across all language layouts and input fields without restrictions. Restart Gboard to apply changes.

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_backend_type_summary
string.translation: If you select AI CORE or ASTREA, your account or device must be eligible to enable it.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_summary
string.translation: Controls whether Advanced Voice Typing is forced on.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_header_summary
string.translation: Voice typing -> Advanced features, Add punctuation

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_error_summary
string.translation: The Advanced Voice Typing settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_enabled_summary
string.translation: Activate Pixel Rambler voice dictation for fast on-device speech-to-text with automatic punctuation. Restart Gboard to apply changes.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_supported_languages_summary
string.translation:
Only en-US supports the complete feature set.

English en-AU, en-CA, en-GB, en-IE, en-IN, en-SG, en-US
German de-AT, de-BE, de-CH, de-DE
French fr-BE, fr-CA, fr-CH, fr-FR
Italian it-CH, it-IT
Japanese ja-JP
Spanish es-ES, es-US

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_github_star_summary
string.translation: This feature took a significant amount of time to build. If it helps you, please give the project a Star on GitHub.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_speech_services_status_summary
string.translation: Package: com.google.android.tts. Required for Advanced Voice Typing: install Speech Recognition & Synthesis and download the offline speech recognition model for every language you use. Tap to open its Google Play page.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_speech_services_open_failed
string.translation: Unable to open the Speech Recognition & Synthesis Google Play page.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_unsupported_summary
string.translation: This Android version cannot query downloaded offline languages.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_unavailable_summary
string.translation: No on-device speech recognition service is available.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_downloaded_languages_error_summary
string.translation: Unable to read downloaded offline languages. Check them in Live Transcribe.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_live_transcribe_manage_summary
string.translation: Use Google’s official Live Transcribe app to download the Speech Recognition & Synthesis offline recognition models required for Advanced Voice Typing. In Live Transcribe, open Settings → More settings → Primary language.\nTap to open Live Transcribe.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_live_transcribe_open_failed
string.translation: Unable to open Live Transcribe or its Google Play page.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_present_summary
string.translation: The currently installed %1$s meets the APK payload requirement for Advanced Voice Typing.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_present_requirement_summary
string.translation: No download is needed right now. For future updates or reinstalls, you must still use a bundle or split APKM and apply the patch with PixelBoard Patcher; a standalone APK cannot work.\nTap to view the APKMirror download page

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_absent_summary
string.translation: The currently installed %1$s does not contain libdictation_jni.so, which Advanced Voice Typing requires.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_absent_requirement_title
string.translation: Get a bundle or split APKM

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_absent_requirement_summary
string.translation: Get a bundle or split APKM and apply the patch with PixelBoard Patcher; a standalone APK cannot work.\nTap to open the APKMirror download page

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_unknown_summary
string.translation: The installed APK files for the selected Gboard package could not be inspected.

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_payload_unknown_requirement_summary
string.translation: It is currently unclear whether another download is needed. Verify that you used a bundle or split APKM and applied the patch with PixelBoard Patcher; a standalone APK cannot work.\nTap to view the APKMirror download page
